Kaya Financial is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our payments platform team. You will own backend services written in Node.js and TypeScript, backed by PostgreSQL and deployed on Kubernetes.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent experience
- At least 5 years of backend engineering experience
- Strong Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL
- Production experience with Kubernetes

Perks and Benefits
- HMO on day one with two dependents
- Hybrid setup, three days onsite
- Annual performance bonus
